exposure: Fetal Inflammatory Response (FIR) on placental histopathology (presence and severity)
cohort: The study included 1,696 term neonates with meconium-stained amniotic fluid born at Parkland Hospital between 2010 and 2018.
finding: Fetal Inflammatory Response (FIR), particularly its severity, is an independent predictor of Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS), with moderate to severe FIR conferring 5-times higher odds.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS) in univariate analysis.
